summary: Implemented the single-phase plan for task 830 (aerc terminal C-hjkl/Esc passthrough) in lua/neotex/config/keymaps.lua's set_terminal_keymaps(). Added 'local is_aerc = bufname:match("aerc") ~= nil' after the is_opencode detection block; extended the <Esc> guard to 'if not is_claude and not is_aerc then'; and inserted an intentionally-empty 'elseif is_aerc then' branch (no buf_map calls, no early return) between the is_opencode branch and the generic else in the <C-hjkl> conditional, so <C-hjkl> pass through unmapped to the aerc pty. The unconditional <M-*> resize binds and winfixbuf remain untouched. Diff matches the plan exactly (net +5/-1 lines). Headless load check (nvim --headless -c "luafile lua/neotex/config/keymaps.lua" -c "q") passed with exit code 0 and no Lua errors.
decisions_made: is_aerc detection uses bufname:match('aerc') ~= nil (mirroring is_claude), placed immediately after the is_opencode detection block.
Gated <Esc> by extending the guard to 'if not is_claude and not is_aerc then'.

Gated <C-hjkl> via an intentionally-empty 'elseif is_aerc then' branch (comment only, no buf_map calls, no early return), preserving the unconditional <M-*> resize binds after the if/elseif/else block.
dead_ends: Did not use an early-return for the is_aerc <C-hjkl> branch -- confirmed the unconditional <M-*> resize binds still execute for aerc terminals.
Did not use the is_opencode vim.b.snacks_terminal.cmd idiom for is_aerc -- toggleterm stores only an opaque toggle_number in vim.b, not a cmd string.
